  <script>
    function setFrequency(freq) {
      var onetimeGrid = document.getElementById('grid-onetime');
      var monthlyGrid = document.getElementById('grid-monthly');
      var onetimeBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-onetime');
      var monthlyBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-monthly');
      var customOnetime = document.getElementById('custom-link-onetime');
      var customMonthly = document.getElementById('custom-link-monthly');

      if (freq === 'monthly') {
        onetimeGrid.style.display = 'none';
        monthlyGrid.style.display = 'grid';
        onetimeBtn.classList.remove('freq-active');
        monthlyBtn.classList.add('freq-active');
        customOnetime.style.display = 'none';
        customMonthly.style.display = 'inline-flex';
      } else {
        onetimeGrid.style.display = 'grid';
        monthlyGrid.style.display = 'none';
        onetimeBtn.classList.add('freq-active');
        monthlyBtn.classList.remove('freq-active');
        customOnetime.style.display = 'inline-flex';
        customMonthly.style.display = 'none';
      }
    }
